name: AWS S3 Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of Amazon S3 storage configurations. Covers bucket policies, ACLs, public access settings, encryption, logging, versioning, cross-account access, and data exfiltration risks.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to S3 security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands S3 access control mechanisms and common misconfiguration patterns
evidence: Can explain bucket policies, ACLs (disabled by default via S3 Object Ownership since 2023), and Block Public Access settings
Understands S3 encryption options (SSE-S3, SSE-KMS, DSSE-KMS, SSE-C)
Familiar with common S3 data exposure incidents

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Enumerates and reviews S3 configurations under supervision
evidence: Uses tools to scan for publicly accessible buckets and objects
Reviews bucket policies for overly permissive access under guidance
Documents S3 security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses S3 security posture across accounts
evidence: Independently identifies misconfigured bucket policies and ACLs
Evaluates cross-account S3 access and data exfiltration risks
Assesses S3 logging, versioning, and encryption configurations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex S3 security scenarios including data flow analysis and exfiltration simulation
evidence: Identifies subtle data exposure through pre-signed URLs and cross-account trust
Develops automated S3 configuration audit tooling
Reviews S3 assessment work of junior analysts
Assesses S3-backed application architectures for data leakage

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab S3 assessment methodology; discovers novel S3 attack vectors
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's S3 security assessment methodology
Published research on S3 security bypass techniques or data exfiltration
Trains teams on advanced S3 security assessment

assessment_methods.description: Assess a multi-account S3 environment with intentional misconfigurations and identify all data exposure risks
Review S3 security findings from recent cloud assessment engagements

cis: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0 - Section 2.1 Simple Storage Service (S3)
